description: Create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' containing the manual action steps for the developer. The API test confirmed a 401 response (key is expired/not set). The code in app/api/riot/route.ts already handles 401/403 gracefully by returning 503 with 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later'. No code changes are needed. The only action required is creating the GitHub issue. PR #19 exists as a PR but NOT as a standalone issue. Use the GitHub API via curl to create the issue, or document the limitation if write access is not available.
steps: Attempt to create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' on QuanFaiyaz/kiro-web-league-tracker using the available GitHub power tools or any API method

The issue body must contain exactly: ## Action Required (Manual Steps)

1. Log in at https://developer.riotgames.com/ and regenerate your API key
2. Copy the new key and update .env.local: RIOT_API_KEY=RGAPI-your-new-key
3. Restart the dev server (npm run dev) or redeploy to production

**Note:** The app is currently showing 'Service temporarily unavailable' to users until this is resolved.
If issue creation is not possible due to tool limitations, document this clearly in the feature findings field
Verify the build still passes with bun run build
Verify linting passes with bun run lint
acceptance_criteria: A GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' exists, OR the limitation is clearly documented
No code changes are needed since app/api/riot/route.ts already handles 401/403
findings: GitHub issue creation was NOT possible due to tool limitations. The available kiro GitHub power tools do not include a create_issue tool. The gh CLI is installed but NOT authenticated. Direct GitHub API calls via curl return 401 (no token available in the environment). The gateway URL (us-east-1.gateway.connections.autonomous-agents.kiro.dev) only supports git operations, not the GitHub REST API for issues. Verified: bun run build passes successfully, bun run lint passes with zero errors. No code changes were needed since app/api/riot/route.ts already handles 401/403 gracefully by returning HTTP 503 with 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later'. The user must manually create the GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' on QuanFaiyaz/kiro-web-league-tracker.
